user.title: Connect Qidong Water
user.description: Enter the wid from the WeChat water-payment request. Treat it as a credential. Bound water accounts are discovered automatically, including accounts added later.

data_description.wid: The wid inside the param JSON sent to getTotalNew.action; the history endpoint uses the same value as wxid.

error.cannot_connect: Unable to connect to the Qidong Water service.
error.invalid_response: The service returned an unexpected response. Check whether the wid is still valid.
error.no_accounts: Connected successfully, but no bound water accounts were found.
error.unknown: Unexpected error. Check the Home Assistant log.

init.title: Qidong Water options
init.description: Configure refresh interval, monthly tier limits and prices. Base water charges are progressive. The integration reloads after saving.

data_description.update_interval: Enter a whole number from 1 to 168; 6 means every 6 hours.
data_description.tier1_limit: Tier 1 upper limit, default 25. Usage above this limit enters tier 2.
data_description.tier2_limit: Cumulative tier 2 upper limit, default 35. Must exceed the first limit; excess usage enters tier 3.

error.invalid_interval: Enter a whole number of hours from 1 to 168.
error.invalid_limit: The usage boundary must be greater than zero.
error.invalid_tier_order: The second boundary must exceed the first boundary.
